newsitem.title: USA: Stone Container files $1 bln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Stone Container files $1 bln shelf.

text.p: Stone Container Corp said Monday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1 billion in debt securities, preferred and common stock.

Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including working capital, the repayment or refinancing of indebtedness, future acquisitions and/or capital expenditures, Stone said in the filing.
Stone, based in Chicago, Ill., is an international pulp and paper company engaged principally in the production and sale of paper, packaging products and market pulp.
